Treatment summary
Patient presents following a sideswipe clolision that occurred while the vehicle was changing lanes. Presenting complaints
consisted of neck pain, stiffness, and limited cervical range of motion, with associated muscle guarding noted on examination.
The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of impact and with the pattern of symptoms described. Imaging and
physical examination findings clearly confirm a cervical strain. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from the patient's
history or available records. Conservative management was provided over fifteen visits, including manual therapy, therapeutic
exercise, and home stretching instruction. Care followed a typical course, with pain intensity and range of motion improving
steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient progressed. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges
for each service rendered, with no duplicate billing identified. At discharge the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and
was advised to continue a home exercise program and return if symptoms recur.
